name: highlightz-campaigns-promo
description: 30-second Highlightz Campaigns promo: Remotion compositions, capture rig and audio.

scripts.render:all: npm run check-data && npm run render:16x9 && npm run render:9x16 && npm run render:teaser && npm run render:teaser:9x16 && npm run render:thumb
scripts.render:ad: remotion render src/index.ts DuxAd out/duxxion-ad-video-only.mp4 --muted --crf 12 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/duxxion-ad-video-only.mp4 -i public/ad/duxxion-ad.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -shortest out/highlightz-duxxion-ad.mp4
scripts.render:gta: remotion render src/index.ts GtaAd out/gta-ad-video-only.mp4 --muted --crf 12 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/gta-ad-video-only.mp4 -i public/ad-gta/gta-ad.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -shortest out/highlightz-gta6-ad.mp4
